headline: 魔法壞女巫演員談金曲
context: 音樂劇《Wicked》（魔法壞女巫）的演員們，分享自己最愛在台上唱的歌曲。首位飾演艾芙芭（Elphaba）的百老匯傳奇伊迪娜．曼佐（Idina Menzel），也在受訪之列。她曾以此角拿下東尼獎，並在電影版中客串演出。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The musical powerhouse has spawned huge hits, but which do its troupers love to belt out – even for the 1,700th time? From Broadway legend Idina Menzel to composer Stephen Schwartz, they reveal all Idina Menzel originated the role of Elphaba, the witch of the west who turns out not to be so wicked (but still very green) . She won a Tony on Broadway, starred in the West End run and made a cheeky cameo in the recent film version Continue reading...
sources.title: ‘They’ll never bring us dowwwwwwwn!’ Wicked’s stars pick their favourite songs from the smash hit

thread_text:
魔法壞女巫演員談金曲

音樂劇《Wicked》的演員們，分享自己最愛在台上唱的歌曲。首位飾演艾芙芭（Elphaba）的百老匯傳奇伊迪娜．曼佐（Idina Menzel），也在受訪之列。她曾以此角拿下東尼獎，並在電影版中客串演出。

—— 本則來自衛報 2026 年 9 月 30 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
